item.title: The foldable iPhone Ultra could disappoint a whole bunch of eager buyers
item.summary: Alternate descriptive headlines iPhone Ultra could launch in the U.S. first as Apple battles supply and production issues Apple’s first foldable iPhone may face a very limited international rollout iPhone Ultra supply problems could leave some countries waiting months Apple may unveil the iPhone Ultra before it is ready for a full global launch Foldable iPhone shortages could make the iPhone Ultra hard to buy at launch Apple may prioritize the U.S. for the first wave of iPhone Ultra sales iPhone Ultra launch could be delayed in some markets despite a September unveiling Apple’s foldable iPhone may arrive in stages as supply remains tight Excerpt options Apple’s first foldable iPhone could launch in the U.S. first, with supply, pricing, and production issues potentially delaying availability in other markets. The rumored iPhone Ultra may be unveiled this fall but remain difficult to buy, with some countries potentially waiting months for stock. Apple could face a very limited rollout for its first foldable iPhone, as production and supply problems reportedly threaten wider availability.
